name: io.github.jangsejong/tistory-mcp
title: Tistory MCP (Unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for Tistory blogs: publish, edit, drafts, images. Private by default.

environmentVariables.name: TISTORY_MCP_SESSION_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Where the blog session cookies are kept: a 0600 file under the config directory, or the OS keyring.

environmentVariables.name: TISTORY_MCP_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Minimum number of seconds between publish/update calls. 0 disables the interval.

environmentVariables.name: TISTORY_MCP_DAILY_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of publish/update calls per day. 0 disables the cap.

environmentVariables.name: TISTORY_MCP_ALLOW_ANY_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow blog hosts outside *.tistory.com (custom domains). Unset by default: only *.tistory.com is accepted.
